ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels, with high-intensity areas localized at the distal extremities of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches on the outer 30% of the left lobe and outer 25% of the right lobe. These patches feature irregular black dendritic intrusions. The central 60% of the fluke is dominated by low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at the center with an approximate 50-degree interior angle; vertical depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels. Edge is characterized by jagged peaks and valleys, particularly dense on the inner margins near the notch and along the outer left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edges transitioning to convex curvature at the distal tips; lobes taper significantly toward the lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible cluster of circular high-contrast white pixels at the extreme left distal tip; scattered small circular white points across the dark pigmented regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned, diagonal light-grey linear marks approximately 100-150 pixels in length on the dark surface of the right lobe, appearing as rake-like disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep healed notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe; vertical rake marks on the right lobe surface; significant edge erosion on the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ink-drop' mottling pattern where black pigment bleeds into the white distal patches on both lobes.
